title: The Flash Loan Machine
description: Step through a flash loan transaction — three strategies (triangular arb, collateral swap, self-liquidation), same atomic structure. The amber step is the only place the AI agent reasons; everything after it is deterministic EVM. Tap a strategy chip, then tap any step.
controls: tap a strategy chip to load its execution steps
tap any step box to inspect the actor, action, and constraint
